blocks.text: The reality of project manager authority

When you ask can a project manager fire you, the answer depends on your company hierarchy. In most organizations, a project manager is responsible for the project timeline and resources, not your employment contract. HR and your direct supervisor usually handle firing decisions. If a project manager is dissatisfied with your work, they will typically report their concerns to your functional manager.

Personnel clarification is the process of defining who does what, who decides what, and who is accountable for project outcomes. When this is missing, you face role ambiguity. This causes stress because you do not know if your tasks align with project goals.

items: Vague project objectives at the start.
Create a RACI chart: List tasks and mark who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed.
Document decisions: Use a shared Notion page or Excel file to record agreements.
Request alignment meetings: Ask for a 15 minute sync to review your specific task list.
Confirm via email: Always send a summary after verbal conversations to establish a paper trail.

faq.question: Can a project manager fire you directly?
faq.answer: Generally, no. They provide performance feedback to your direct manager, who makes employment decisions.

faq.question: What is a RACI matrix?
faq.answer: It is a tool used to clarify roles by assigning responsibility and accountability for each project task.
